intro: The Broken Construct involves lending aid to Riaani Nightwind, who is shoulder-deep inside the innards of an inoperable machine. Sent as an assistant by Ayessa, travelers must listen to Riaani's plans to discover how they can help restore the device.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Oh, hello. Ayessa sent you to assist me? Very well then.
Not sure what an obvious novice like yourself can do, but if you give me a moment to pull my head out of this construct's innards I might have a few ideas of things you can do to help.
